boundaries: Independent peer only. Root alone writes adoption/index decisions.
No pooled binomial interval across phases or shared policy/layout seed repetitions.
Wilson intervals apply to each fixed policy/layout group.
Finite endless success means campaign plus2 endless clears, never indefinite survival.
All pressure samples include zeros among observed entries. Target zero-time next-stage entry is right-censored separately.
No human win-rate, physical-device, real-wall-clock comfort or indefinite-survival inference.

losslessSplit.rule: Read each phases[i].path (or equivalent phases[i].source), validate its SHA256, replace that reference with the entire parsed phase object in originalPhaseOrder, then remove only this losslessSplit field. All other overview fields remain exactly as in the original. stableStringify of the reconstructed object must equal the original complete peer.
